newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-BOURSE CAPITALISATION GAINED OVER WEEK.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-BOURSE CAPITALISATION GAINED OVER WEEK.

text.p: The stock exchange said on Friday that the market capitalisation of the bourse rose to 204.62 million lats from 184.04 million lats at the start of the week.
It also said in a statement that its index rose from 378.67 to 388.64 by the end of the week.

Unibanka was the most traded stock at 111,478 lats as it rose to 3.39 lats from 3.19 lats. Olainfarm was second busiest at 76,548 lats and slipped to 2.30 lats from 2.35 lats although it rose as high as 2.45 lats during the week.
Third most busiest stock was Daugavpils Chain on trade of 45,861 lats and it was unchanged throughout the week at 1.07 lats.
